topic: Equinox Chair Leads $6.5M Financing Round for Vesalius Longevity Labs

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Equinox Chair Leads $6.5M Financing Round for Vesalius Longevity Labs

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Harvey Spevak is backing the publicly traded peptide and longevity company as it looks to expand its provider network and enter new markets Vesalius Longevity Labs has raised $6.5 million in a financing round led by an investor group organized by Harvey Spevak, the chairman of luxury fitness and wellness giant Equinox Group. The publicly traded longevity company, formerly known as Sweet Earth Holdings Corporation, completed a private placement of approximately 6.2 million units at $1.05 apiece, generating nearly $6.5 million in gross proceeds. The funding will support Vesalius ‘ plans to expand its sales team, enter new markets and grow its platform connecting licensed healthcare providers with peptide therapies and other longevity-focused offerings. “I believe longevity represents one of the most exciting opportunities in health and wellness over the coming decade,” Spevak said. “Vesalius has an ambitious vision for building a differentiated platform. I’m excited to partner with the team and bring my experience in building consumer-focused brands, driving innovation and creating long-term value to help shape the company’s next phase of growth.” Vesalius operates a provider-focused longevity platform spanning peptides, biologics, preventive healthcare and performance optimization.

topic: Oura to Acquire Counsel Health for $625M in Major Push Into AI-Powered Healthcare

facts.label: Story
facts.value: Oura to Acquire Counsel Health for $625M in Major Push Into AI-Powered Healthcare

facts.label: Article
facts.value: The acquisition marks the smart ring maker’s latest move beyond just wearables, bringing medical AI and physician-led care into its growing health platform Oura is making a $625 million bet that the future of wearables extends beyond tracking health data to connecting consumers directly with medical care. The smart ring maker announced today that it has agreed to acquire Counsel Health , an AI-native primary care company that combines artificial intelligence with access to board-certified physicians. The all-cash transaction, valued at $625 million subject to adjustments, is expected to close before the end of 2026, the sides said. Oura has increasingly positioned itself as a broader health intelligence platform rather than simply a maker of smart rings. The acquisition is a signal that Oura is moving further into healthcare delivery. The acquisition also follows a period of significant growth for Oura. The company reported preliminary fiscal 2026 revenue of approximately $1.75 billion, up 92% year over year, and now has more than six million members. Oura had reportedly been preparing for an IPO this fall but postponed the offering in September amid market uncertainty. The acquisition builds on an existing partnership between Oura and Counsel, which began earlier this year and allows members to access AI-powered medical guidance and physicians directly through the Oura app.

en.headline: Oura to Acquire Counsel Health for $625M in Major Push Into AI-Powered Healthcare

topic: URBAN ARC Go 2 AI fitness band and Q9i AI ANC TWS earbuds launched

facts.label: Story
facts.value: URBAN ARC Go 2 AI fitness band and Q9i AI ANC TWS earbuds launched

facts.label: Article
facts.value: URBAN has expanded its product portfolio in India with the launch of the ARC Go 2 AI Smart Fitness Band and Q9i AI ANC TWS Earbuds. The URBAN ARC Go 2 uses advanced sensors to track heart rate, sleep and stress, along with activity and recovery patterns. Its AI-powered Recovery Function provides personalised recovery insights. The band also supports more than 110 sports modes and 30+ guided meditations, along with sedentary and menstrual reminders. Other features include call and message alerts, music control and gesture-based camera control. The band has a lightweight build with a woven fabric strap and offers up to 45 days of battery life. It also has an IPX68 water-resistance rating. The URBAN Q9i AI ANC TWS Earbuds feature Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) and 13mm dynamic drivers, which the company says deliver powerful bass. They also support AI Live Translation across more than 50 global languages through the AI TransFun app. The integrated Smart Stand allows users to prop up their smartphones for hands-free viewing, such as watching videos or following fitness tutorials. Other features include Bluetooth 6.0 connectivity, a Clear Call HD Mic and Type-C charging. The earbuds offer up to 30 hours of total playtime, with up to 6 hours on a single charge. The URBAN ARC Go 2 AI Smart Fitness Band is priced at Rs. 5,999, while the URBAN Q9i AI ANC TWS Earbuds cost Rs. 4,999.

topic: gantner – Face Recognition: Der Check-in der nächsten Generation

facts.label: Story
facts.value: gantner – Face Recognition: Der Check-in der nächsten Generation

facts.label: Article
facts.value: Smartphone, QR-Code und digitale Mitgliedsausweise gehören heute in vielen Fitnessstudios zum Alltag. Doch die nächste Entwicklungsstufe steht bereits bereit: Face Recognition. Ein kurzer Blick in die Kamera genügt, um ein Mitglied automatisch zu identifizieren, die Berechtigung in der Clubmanagement-Software zu prüfen und den Zutritt freizugeben – ganz ohne Karte, Smartphone oder Armband. Die biometrische Identifikation macht den Check-in nicht nur besonders einfach, sondern auch schnell, kontaktlos und sicher. Durch die eindeutige Identifikation wird sichergestellt, dass ausschließlich berechtigte Personen Zutritt erhalten. Mit GT7 powered by XS4 Face bietet Gantner eine Lösung, die sich nahtlos in bestehende Clubmanagement-Systeme integrieren lässt. Die Mitgliedsdaten werden in Echtzeit mit der Managementsoftware abgeglichen und die Zutrittsentscheidung erfolgt unmittelbar. Dabei bleibt die Zutrittslösung flexibel: Neben Face Recognition können je nach Bedarf auch RFID, QR-Codes oder digitale Mitgliedsausweise eingesetzt werden. Der gesamte Prozess ist DSGVO konform. Für Studiobetreiber eröffnet die automatisierte Gesichtserkennung neue Möglichkeiten, Abläufe effizienter zu gestalten. Der Empfang wird entlastet, Stoßzeiten lassen sich besser bewältigen und auch 24/7- oder personallose Konzepte können von einem automatisierten Zutritt profitieren.

en.headline: gantner – Face Recognition: Der Check-in der nächsten Generation

facts.value: Tastemaker. What’s happening: Elevate, a London-based smoothie bar, secured $2.7M from JamJar Investments, Soho House founder Nick Jones, and others to fuel UK expansion. Whip it. Blending functional ingredients with feel-good flavors, Elevate’s smoothies are created like a supplement stack, packing benefits like glowing skin, gut health, and mental clarity on the go . Selling over a smoothie per minute and doing $1M+ in annual sales, it opened a second site in Selfridges department store in April. Fresh funding will fuel two new shops opening early next year, while viral collabs with Nike, SKIMS, and Adanola boost its status beyond the smoothie bar. Liquid gold. Tapping into consumer willingness to pay for added benefits, smoothies are selling at a premium, promising clean ingredients, functional outcomes, and wellness status . Winning over London, Elevate will join Joe & the Juice , Tease, and Avobar in national expansion. While Cali-famous Erewhon teases its first NYC tonic bar, others are emulating its smoothie-as-a-platform playbook , with Aussie Common Supply and Nude Miami complementing groceries and SunLife Organic lining up brand collabs. Punchline: Turning functional ingredients into high-priced habits, smoothie bars are competing for a place in the wellness routine, with aspirational appeal adding value to the daily dose.
